verdict.rationale: uv's docs say it uses aggressive caching to avoid re-downloading and re-building dependencies from prior runs [uv-docs-25]. A global cache deduplicates dependencies [uv-docs-33], and the official setup-uv action can persist that cache in CI [uv-docs-10], so previously built packages are reused rather than recompiled. One user reports uvx sometimes re-downloading dependencies it had just fetched for another tool [uv-comm-4], which lowers confidence but does not contradict the documented capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prebuilt-wheel selection and how built wheels are stored and reused from the cache, and independent hands-on corroboration that cache hits avoid source builds.
